paragraphs.first: Darinela Vangelova is a Bulgarian soprano based in Vienna. Born in Burgas in 2003, she began her formal training at the National School of Music and Performing Arts "Prof. Pancho Vladigerov," where she studied piano with Zlatina Panteleeva and opera singing with Bilyana Danailova, graduating in 2022. She is now completing the final semester of her Bachelor's degree at the University of Music and Performing Arts Vienna (MDW).
paragraphs.second: Her artistic development has been shaped by masterclasses with Krassimira Stoyanova, Stefka Evstatieva, Valentin Peychinov, Voislav Spasich, and other distinguished teachers. In January 2025 she sang the role of Ilia in Mozart's Idomeneo, and later that year was awarded a scholarship from the Raina Kabaivanska Fund for studies at the Vecchi-Tonelli Institute for the 2025/26 academic year. Alongside her studies, she performs as a soloist with Yehudi Menuhin's Live Music Now in Vienna, bringing hour-long recitals to care homes, hospitals, and audiences who rarely have the chance to hear live music.

Achievements.heading: Critical Acclaim
Achievements.description: From early piano competitions in Bulgaria to opera stages across Europe, Darinela's path has been marked by a steady record of prizes and recognitions from international juries. Each award is less a destination than a milestone but a chance to stand before new audiences, to test her craft against the work of her peers, and to carry her voice a little further.
